scope: Technical capability only; no legal RuleSpec candidate generated or accepted.

checks.scope: Correlated scalar predicates preserve current and related entity contexts in Fast and Explain execution. Conditional scalar operands requested in Fast mode use the documented Explain fallback; the test verifies that fallback and equal results.
count_where accepts related derived judgments and imported relation/predicate composition.

conclusion: The pinned engine supports record associations and derived predicates evaluated on related entities. A generic claim that relation aggregators cannot bind findings to an assessment is not established. These tests do not prove every proposed evidence model or all nested correlations are expressible.
remaining_work: Specify an evidence model grounded in the exact applicable source and test its actual formulas and associations.
Do not impose an unsupported requirement that every medical finding share a single assessment.
Resolve qualitative and temporal legal interpretation from captured sources; runtime tests do not supply legal standards.
encoding_budget_effect: None; no native generation attempt dispatched.
independent_review: Source hashes, exact engine commit and four passing tests independently verified. Clarified conditional-operand Fast-to-Explain fallback; no substantive capability overclaim.
